scheme_name: Establishment of Entrepreneur for Breed Development in Small Ruminant Sector (Sheep and Goat Farming)
other_conditions: Entrepreneur must establish a sheep and goat breeding unit with at least 500 female animals and 25 male animals
Breed must be selected from the approved list or in consultation with the State Government
Three‑year bank guarantee is required for self‑financing projects
Subsidy is not applicable for working capital, personal vehicles, land purchase, or rental/lease costs
Project requires bank appraisal and the entrepreneur must hold a bank account
First 50% of the subsidy is released after verification of 25% infrastructure expenditure, with the remaining amount released after project completion and SIA certification
benefits_summary: Provides up to Rs. 50 lakh capital subsidy (in two equal installments) for establishing sheep‑goat breeding units, encouraging entrepreneurship and organized sector development in the small ruminant sector.
